svg.title: Blood-Enchanted Eyes — Crimson Covenant. Final approved structure (RUL-2026-10-03-006) / Shadow classification / forked tree.
svg.desc: 10 skills, 4 purchases, one Advanced Art maximum. Scarlet Gaze forks into Opened Veins then Rite of Exsanguination, or Crimson Thirst then Feast of the Fallen. Iron in the Blood forks into Closed Wounds then Deathless Vitality, or Carrion Fever then Red Pestilence. No paths converge. Bonuses apply to matching supported tags on all Shadow jutsu.

Scarlet Gaze opens the two offensive routes (Burst +5 Damage; Sustain Offense +5% Lifesteal with a +5% Increase Damage Given rider); Iron in the Blood opens the two defensive routes, which mirror each other (Fortress +10% Decrease Damage Taken with +5% Decrease Damage Given; Suppression +10% Decrease Damage Given with +5% Decrease Damage Taken). There is no Afterburn path in this revision: native Afterburn stays usable but unamplified. g.text: Foundations support. Hidden Arts focus. Advanced Arts define.
1 BP each · Acquire points with silver
Bonuses apply to matching supported tags on all Shadow jutsu. Combat scopes stay unchanged.
Finish a path in 3 purchases. Spend your fourth on support or a sibling Hidden Art.
Any two Advanced Arts require at least 5 points. Your limit is 4.
Each skill purchased once · Only your current bloodline unlocks · No converging paths
Examples are choices, not locked presets. Advanced Arts are optional.
Rite of Exsanguination path + Iron in the Blood
Feast of the Fallen path + Iron in the Blood
IDG: Increase Damage Given · DDG: Decrease Damage Given · IDT: Increase Damage Taken · DDT: Decrease Damage Taken · LS: Lifesteal
FINAL TAG VALUES ON THE BLOOD-ENCHANTED EYES KIT
Jutsu level 25 · main-tree bonuses and bloodline passives excluded
Static bonuses: a 35% tag with +5% becomes 40%. A 40 EP jutsu with +5 Damage becomes 45EP.
Lifesteal shares a 60%-of-hit leech budget with vamp; Reflect returns at most 60% of a hit.
Proposed behavior: needs a jutsu-classification potency resolver. The current resolver matches each effect's own elements.
14 legal four-skill allocations · 4 Advanced Arts available · Combat tuning remains experimental
Final approved structure (RUL-2026-10-03-006) / Shadow classification / forked tree
